row.notes: (lib) Robin-hood hash table: FNV-1a over 16 key bytes times multiplier set+0x20, entries (pointers to 16-byte keys) at +0x28, info bytes at +0x30, count +0x38, mask +0x40, max load +0x48, info increment +0x50, shift +0x54. Finds the key or shifts entries up to make a slot; grows/rehashes through FUN_1426ad5d0 or halves info bits when overflowing; up to 0x100 retries. Writes out[0]=slot index and out[1]=status (1 found, 2/3 slot reserved, 0 failed).
